message: 洋菓子ＶＳ和菓子

name: Tame-san
message: 「Alright, so. This is where my stall's gonna be, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. The academy will provide three helpers, so we're counting on you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And if any problems come up, call my cell.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No matter how reliable I may seem, you must not contact me.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Well, that's a shame. Though I don't know your number anyway, little lady, so I couldn't call you even if I wanted to.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Naturally, since I haven't given it to you.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Haha.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Synn. Somehow I'm starting to get excited too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「It's rare to get a chance to enter the academy fair and square, after all. Maybe I'll hit on a bunch of girls!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pull anything like that and I'll throw you out.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Harsh, aren't you. Well, looking forward to the big day.」

name: Synn
message: 「Same here, we're counting on you.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Don't get so excited that you stay up late or end up jerking off!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-what are you saying, Tame-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking of pulling one out, you mean a shirikodama, right!? I would love to see a shirikodama.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha. Synn's shirikodama is thiiis huge.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright. Enough with the stupid talk. Seriously, we're counting on you that day.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Leave it to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew. That's all the shops setting up stalls greeted, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... I've checked them all off.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, we're dismissed for today!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, isn't it still a bit early?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not at all--we have to get up early tomorrow to prep, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, something's just been bugging me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just your imagination, your imagination.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on just a second, there's still an important matter left.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「An important matter?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What exactly is a shirikodama?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're still on about that?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In my imagination, it's a red ball about the size of a golf ball. And like the cherry on top of anmitsu, I picture it all slimy and wet.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Don't imagine it in such vivid detail!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So a shirikodama really is just as I imagined!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not that--anmitsu.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about anmitsu?」

name: Synn
message: 「While we were making the rounds greeting folks in the shopping district, something kept nagging at the back of my mind... I felt like a bunch of shops were being skipped over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...It's your imagination, just your imagination.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Show me the list.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's going to happen with the shirikodama?」

name: Synn
message: 「That can wait. Ah, I knew it... There isn't a single traditional Japanese sweets shop on here!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's short notice starting now, but what do you say we ask the Japanese sweets shops to set up stalls too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All-you-can-eat anmitsu, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Putting that aside... Anyway, that's why I have a favor to ask Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Weeell then, let's call it a day here so we can get ready for KiraFes tomorrow.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you trying to cover up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, uh, um.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, Yuugiri-an serves anmitsu for dessert, doesn't it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't recall that at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How pitiful. Juvenile amnesia at your young age? Oh, though I suppose it's called juvenile precisely because you're young.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, I heard from your dad that 'Hanamura' supplies it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...My dad's totally unreliable, so you shouldn't believe him.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I heard it when Hikoichi-san, the owner of 'Hanamura,' and your dad were playing Go on the veranda, so there's no mistake.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guh... Saying unnecessary things, that terrible Go player...」

name: Synn
message: 「So anyway, I want to have your dad put in a word for us and negotiate to get at least 'Hanamura' to open a stall, but.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'no'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Western sweets are plenty! We don't need any Japanese sweets!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's blatantly a personal reason. Talk about might making right.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like that proverb is slightly off. Besides, Nanaka, you were wolfing down anmitsu at your own place, weren't you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You promised not to bring that up!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, come on, just because you don't get along with Misasagi-senpai, isn't badmouthing Japanese sweets going too far?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really is a personal reason!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Anyway! KiraFes is right around the corner, there's no space left at this point, so no way, no way, no way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me... Nanaka, you deliberately skipped all the Japanese sweets shops and filled up all the booth spaces, didn't you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Gasp*」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't flinch like that, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I did not flinch! Still, as a practical matter, it's impossible now! When I say no way, I mean no way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you've got the connections. You can secure space for at least one shop, right? Right, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood! Failure is crystal clear right from the start, but I'll give it a shot even if it means going down in flames! Just leave it all to me like you're riding on a big, sturdy ship!」

name: Synn
message: 「...If we ask Misa, she'll probably figure something out, and there are plenty of people who like wagashi too, so cutting down on their fun just because of Nanaka's stubbornness is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody like that exists in this world!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a bold claim, Treasurer. Though it's already falling apart the moment you said it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bubuzuke!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Sweets Society's hated rival, the president of the Wagashi Club!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Misasagi-senpai. She's often with Ria-senpai.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong, it's Bubuzuke!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's not human, so it doesn't count!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's discrimination. There are even angels and Demons in this world. Ah, of course, I'm not an angel, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Before all that, Senpai is human, isn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「If Nanaka says she won't do it, let's get Misasagi-senpai to help us out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Boo-boo.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's Senpai, she probably has connections with wagashi shops.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, it's a case of the doctor not taking their own medicine.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't even know where to start retorting.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're gonna say that, it's 'leave it to the specialists'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'd hang myself before borrowing help from someone like her!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. In that case, I'll accidentally pull on your legs.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who's gonna die?! Look, asking that woman to negotiate is impossible in the first place. After all, Bubuzuke is hated by wagashi shops.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, take a look.」
Nanaka said, pointing at the wagashi shop.
In the small tatami-style cafe corner inside the shop sat Misasagi-senpai, kneeling neatly in seiza.
Hikoichi-san had just brought some traditional Japanese sweets over there.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. Those look delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since they're yellowish... maybe they're the kind of sweets made with eggs?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, Synn. Right now, old man Hikoichi is peeking up at her in terror while asking for her verdict, isn't he.」

name: Synn
message: 「It just looks like he's greeting her politely to me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah. You lack observation skills! Look, she just answered him all high and mighty, didn't she.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, the old man is groveling and bowing his head off!」

name: Synn
message: 「It looks like he just asked for her thoughts and she's answering calmly, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I bet she tore them to shreds without mercy! What an awful woman!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if he's only making things like Japanese sweets, you should still show proper respect to someone who makes food! What a rude jerk!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not observation skills, that's delusion skills.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hate the monk, hate him until \{this morning|\s12\s12}. You end up hating him all night until morning and can't get any sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「I agree with the first half, but the second half makes zero sense.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After tearing his food to shreds like that, she probably threatens to tell the whole town it tastes awful and extorts free sweets in return! No doubt about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where you get that certainty from is the real mystery here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think she's picking up radio waves.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, isn't she awful? Way I see it, she must be sweet-talking him by promising to spread word that it's delicious, gorging on sweets without spending a dime of her own!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She probably thinks she's the JIS standard for Japanese confectioners in this town or something! Unforgivable!」
No, if anyone's the JIS standard for Western confectioners in this town, isn't that you, Nanaka?

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Nanaka. Even supposing things are just like you say, if it's Misasagi-senpai, I'd think getting a Japanese sweets shop to open a stall would be easy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, are you saying we should borrow the power of evil just to get more stalls! That's not something an ally of justice does!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being Crusaders is a side gig, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that even comes up, Misasagi-senpai isn't evil, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. Everyone is gathered here. Good afternoon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hehe. That attitude is far too childish, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr... Hello.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Misasagi-senpai, I have a favor to ask. Could you at least hear me out?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Since it is a personal request from the President whom Rii-a adores so much, I will gladly take it on as best I can, so do go ahead and tell me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We don't have anything to ask of someone like her.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The one who has a favor to ask of me is the President. Bystanders ought to keep their mouths shut.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not a bystander! I'm an officer of the Student Council too.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I see, so this is a matter concerning the Student Council. Could it be... about tomorrow's KiraFes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, that's right. I figured you might have some pull with the Japanese sweets shops in Ryuusei Town, Misasagi-senpai--how about it?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not quite as much pull as your Treasurer over there has with the Western pastry shops, mind you... Though since I buy from them quite often, I suppose I might be of a little help.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After threatening the Japanese sweets shops nonstop--mmph, mmph, mmph.」
While covering Nanaka's mouth, I said,

name: Synn
message: 「Actually... as embarrassing as it is, I only just realized that we don't have a single Japanese sweets stall at KiraFes.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, even if it's last-minute, I'm hoping to negotiate with them to open a stall. And when I do, I'd like to borrow your influence, Senpai.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Very well. Is what I would like to say, however...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In time for KiraFes--that really is awfully sudden, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's where a time machine comes in!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where on earth would we find one of those.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... well, the guidebook said that's a handy line to use at times like this.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, it seems I am terribly feared by the Japanese sweets shopkeepers, so if I put in a quick word for you, things might just work out somehow.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, Synn! I told you it was true!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh, what am I supposed to do here as Student Council President!? Should I liven up KiraFes even if it means borrowing a slightly shady power!? Or should I stick to my principles!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just kidding, that was a lie.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Could it be... that person over there was saying something like that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make it sound like I'm making things up out of thin air! Synn, don't believe a word this guy says, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It exists inside everyone's heart. That is a good, multi-purpose line.」

name: Synn
message: 「...What does.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The time machine, of course.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You went out of your way to look that up so thoroughly? What an amusing kid.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please call me serious, not amusing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are also others, such as 'Of all words of mice and men, the saddest are, "It might have been."'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am a fountain of knowledge, so please keep asking me questions.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, we don't need that kind of trivia.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm really sorry to spring this on you so suddenly, but. Could I ask a favor of you?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you ask me like that, I can't very well turn you down flat, especially since it's a favor from the President whom Rii-a dotes on like she wants to lick him up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn... she's doting on you!? And like she wants to lick you up?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lick him up...? Does that mean getting licked all over your body?」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't been licked all over my body, though I might be getting doted on.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He answered completely deadpan!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I like that. That kind of honest reaction. Nothing complicated about it--it's refreshing for the soul. I'll gladly take you up on it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh-heh-heh. It's pointless, so don't bother.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, that's a strange thing to say. Why is it pointless?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If Bubuzuke were the only one in trouble, I'd just keep my mouth shut, but I'd hate for you to get dragged into it too, Synn, so I'm telling you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, it's tomorrow, so there's no way you'll make it in time even if you start negotiating now! And besides, all the venues are completely booked anyway!」

name: Synn
message: 「Crap, that's right.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I see. So you went and pulled a move like that beforehand, did you? How mean.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not the one who schemed this! It's just plain too late!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If it were a week ago, though, I reckon things would've turned out quite differently.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's finally time for a time machine, isn't it! Where is it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, it's right inside your heart, of course.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you going to pull it out of my heart?! That sounds painful!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way a time machine exists.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At least not anywhere right now, anyway. What I used was another sci-fi classic--precognition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Precognition...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you really weren't human after all!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It was about a week ago, I suppose... Rii-a asked me to handle things nicely for her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Handle what?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Negotiating with the Japanese sweets shops.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So Ria-senpai time-traveled back a week ago and asked you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's move away from that topic, okay.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「When Rii-a tells me, 'Take good care of it for me,' in that clumsy accent of hers, there's simply no way I could refuse.」
There's no way Nanaka would ever negotiate with the Japanese sweets shops, after all. Thank you, Senpai.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about the venue! There's no way you can secure one now!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Word is that Rii-a already secured one under a different pretext.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no need to bow your head to me. Rii-a's the one you ought to be thanking.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then you should've just said so from the start!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well now, if I'd told you a week ago I was doing this, wouldn't you have objected?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! Sure, I might've complained a little, and personally I hate traditional Japanese sweets, but expanding the variety of stalls is a good thing.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now don't get all worked up--saying you'd object was just a little joke.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not what I'm mad about!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the time you met up with me today, everything was already settled, wasn't it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then before dragging things out with all that slimy back-and-forth over whether you'd take it on, you should've just spit out right away that Ria-senpai asked you to do it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't that kinda make me look like the bad guy...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, if I'd done that, I wouldn't have been able to enjoy our little chat nearly as much. I really do quite like talking with you, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well I hate it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A textbook case of unrequited love.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed it is. Simply tragic. I might just shed a tear.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How is any of this tragic!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bubuzuke. You really are a total jerk.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And here I am a veritable saint... How sorrowful it is to be so misunderstood.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're a saint, then that makes me a literal god.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Aren't the two of them actually pretty close?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Their conversational rhythm is completely in sync.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, you really ought to go see an ear doctor.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right. Despite how it looks, we're actually on the exact same wavelength.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Liar!」
